title: Understanding and predicting the environmental dispersion of iron oxide nanoparticles: a comprehensive study on synthesis, characterisation, and modelling
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D3EN00860F, Paper
